warnings: A six-cutting four-material cycle is 2+2+1+1 in sequence order, not two of each.

loadedFixture.notes: Six cuttings are 2+2+1+1 in cycle order, not two of each. Twelve cuttings are three of each.

pixelRatio.note: devicePixelRatio is not a device-mode label; renderer pixel ratio may be capped below the device ratio.

notes: CSS viewport is the canvas layout size (getBoundingClientRect), not the browser window and not a device-mode label.
Browser window innerWidth/innerHeight is the window, not the canvas CSS viewport.
Drawing-buffer width/height are the WebGL backing store pixels, not CSS pixels.
devicePixelRatio is the browser-reported ratio; renderer pixel ratio may be capped separately.
Draw calls and triangles are resource counts from one render, not FPS or phone performance.
